messages:
tara: Heads-up: PM wants routing header -> unified policy change in 7 weeks. We need a low-friction SDK and console plan that keeps billing stable. Thoughts?
leo: For SDKs, do an adapter layer that maps legacy X-Routing to new `routing.policy` payload. Default ON for 2 releases, then OFF. Emit a single deprecation warning at startup.
annie: Console: we can add a "Routing migration" admin page that previews mappings and exports a CSV for outreach. Also a banner pointing to migration docs. No per-user toasts.
mohit: Quotas: current quota keys are header-derived. Proposal: alias old keys to new policy keys for 60 days and run a reconcile job to merge counters. Billing wants an audit log of the aliasing.
infra-bot: Job scheduled: route-quota-reconcile -> dry-run 2024-06-15 02:00 UTC :gear:
tara: Telemetry ask: add `routing.source` tag (values: legacy, unified, proxy). Also add `sdk.lang` and `sdk.version` to help detect proxy rewrites (if sdk.version >= adapter && source==legacy -> proxy likely).
leo: Python plan: release 1.7.0 adapter that warns (DeprecationWarning) and copies header->body. 1.8.0 flips default false and exposes `REDWOOD_LEGACY_ROUTING=1` env var. Add `--simulate-unified` CLI flag for SEs.
annie: Dashboard tile: top 10 tenants by legacy usage + week-over-week delta. Add column for suspected_proxy_rewrite.
mohit: Backfill window capped at 30d for storage reasons. We'll run off-peak. alias writes for 60d then reconcile.
tara: Docs: include Envoy snippet and migration examples. Devex: please add unit tests ensuring `routing.source` emitted correctly per SDK path.
leo: TS note: keep types stable. Export `RoutingCompat` with `{enabled: boolean}` default true initially. Use `console.warn` in browsers and `process.emitWarning` in node.
annie: Support CSV fields: tenant_id, api_key_hash, legacy_pct, mapped_policy_preview, suspected_proxy_rewrite, owner_email.
mohit: Timeline draft: Week0 announce; Week1 telemetry + console banner; Week2-5 SDK adapters; Week6 flip defaults in SDKs; Week9 stop accepting legacy header server-side with 2-week rollback.	infra-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.internal/checklists/route-unify-1761111111 :white_check_mark:
tara: I'll own docs + comms. Assigning owners in checklist. Any blockers?
leo: minor: ensure SDKs expose a single global opt-out to avoid per-call perf cost.
annie: ack. thanks all :thumbsup:
